  "visibleText": "{\n  \"activeFile\": \"/.agent-github-plans/PR-5/comment-5464512614.md\",\n  \"cursorLine\": 20,\n  \"cursorChar\": 204,\n  \"visibleText\": \"# 📋 PR #5 — Beta v5 GitHub agent\\n\\n| Field | Value |\\n|-------|-------|\\n| **Repo** | PratimeshTiwari/Gemini-Agent |\\n| **Branch** | `beta-v5-github-agent` |\\n| **PR Link** | [#5](https://github.com/PratimeshTiwari/Gemini-Agent/pull/5) |\\n| **Plan Created** | 2026-08-29T19:53:33.291Z |\\n\\n---\\n<!-- comment-id: 5464512614 -->\\n## 📝 Requires AI Review\\n\\n**By**: @PratimeshTiwari · **At**: 8/30/2026, 1:21:51 AM · **Confidence**: 100%\\n\\n🔗 [View Comment](https://github.com/PratimeshTiwari/Gemini-Agent/pull/5#issuecomment-5464512614)\\n\\n### 💬 Original Comment\\n\\n> can we define stages in the github code exploration plan with deeper insights into finding rca and pattern instead of llm guesseing and with open questions asking to users for planned and correct insight instead of guess work\\n\\n### 🧠 AI Context Analysis\\n\\n## 🧠 AI Context Analysis\\n\\n### Problem Summary\\nThe current GitHub code exploration plan generator is relying too heavily on static analysis, predetermined checklists (e.g., \\\"Identify untested code\\\", \\\"Reproduce bug locally\\\"), and assumptions (like \\\"The reviewer's comment applies to the latest commit\\\"). The author of PR #5 (@PratimeshTiwari) correctly points out that these static assumptions lead to the LLM \\\"guessing\\\" the root cause (RCA) and next steps rather than actively exploring the codebase to find patterns. The user is asking to break the plan down into structured stages centered around *discovery, root cause analysis, and pattern matching*, and to explicitly prompt the agent to ask clarifying questions to the human rather than making assumptions.\\n\\n### Relevant Files Found\\nBased on the codebase exploration, the primary file handling this logic is:\\n\\n- **`server/src/github/PlanGenerator.js`**: Specifically the `_buildCommentSection` method (lines 151-250), which dynamically writes the markdown plan for each PR comment.\\n\\nCurrently, this function writes rigid, hardcoded checklists in the `### ✅ Action Items` block and populates a generic `### ⚠️ Assumptions` block that does not encourage interactive human validation.\\n\\n### Concrete Action Items\\n- **Refactor `_buildCommentSection` in `PlanGenerator.js`:**\\n\\n- **Remove Hardcoded Checklists:** Delete the static `if/else` block starting at line 216 that generates generic action items (e.g., `- [ ] Identify the untested code paths`).\\n\\n- **Introduce Explicit Exploration Stages:** Replace the `✅ Action Items` section with a structured, multi-stage exploration plan:\\n\\n- `### Stage 1: Codebase Exploration & Context Gathering` (Use search/read tools to map out dependencies).\\n\\n- `### Stage 2: Root Cause Analysis (RCA)` (Formulate a hypothesis based on actual file data, not guesses).\\n\\n- `### Stage 3: Proposed Implementation Pattern` (Define how to fix it before writing code).\\n\\n- **Transform the \\\"Assumptions\\\" Block into an \\\"Open Questions\\\" Block:**\\n\\n- Change the `### ⚠️ Assumptions (Clear These Before Proceeding)` header at line 239 to `### ❓ Open Clarification Questions`.\\n\\n- Add an explicit directive in the markdown instructing the LLM: *\\\"Do not guess. If the root cause or correct implementation pattern is ambiguous after Stage 1, pause execution and ask the user for clarification.\\\"*\\n\\n- **Update Prompt Injection Logic:**\\n\\n- If `aiAnalysis` (passed into `generateCommentPlan` at line 49) is missing, ensure the fallback static text aligns with this new staged approach rather than reverting to the old checklist.\\n\\n### Test Strategy\\n- **Unit Tests (`server/src/github/PlanGenerator.test.js`):** Modify existing tests that expect the old hardcoded action items to assert the presence of `Stage 1`, `Stage 2`, and `Stage 3` headers in the generated Markdown output.\\n\\n- **Integration Testing:** Trigger a mock PR comment event locally. Inspect the generated `.agent-github-plans/PR-<num>.md` file to confirm the rigid checklists are gone and the new \\\"Open Clarification Questions\\\" section is prominent.\\n\\n- **End-to-End Evaluation:** Post a vague comment on a local staging PR. Verify that the agent reads the newly structured plan, performs codebase exploration first (using tools like `grep_search`), and subsequently *asks a clarifying question* rather than immediately attempting to guess a fix.\\n\\n### ⚠️ Assumptions (Clear These Before Proceeding)\\n\\n1. **Assumed**: The reviewer's comment applies to the current latest commit.\\n2. **Assumed**: No other related PRs are currently modifying this exact code path.\\n*(Agent note: I will explicitly list any technical assumptions I make during the implementation phase here)*\",\n  \"timestamp\": 1788033498280\n}",
